novelty.justification: The hypothesis that an "'answer commitment' point" is "linearly decodable from the residual stream" and can drive a "training-free early-exit controller" proposes a combined temporal belief-probing and early-exit mechanism. Searches around "activation probe answer commitment chain-of-thought early exit," "latent answer residual stream reasoning," and "probe-guided early exit CoT" identify the closest work as Reasoning Theater: Disentangling Model Beliefs from Chain-of-Thought (2026), which already reports answers decodable far earlier than verbalization and probe-guided early exit with comparable accuracy; Post-Hoc Reasoning in Chain of Thought: Decoding and Steering Pre-Committed Answers (2026) additionally studies linear residual-stream probes for pre-committed answers. The step to tracking stability across generation tokens is at most a natural extension of that same mechanism and measurement, so the claim is essentially equivalent in its core prediction and intended use rather than a substantively new research bet.
